result.summary: Reviewed the full REQ-036 diff (git diff master...HEAD) against docs/agents/design/REQ-036.md and docs/agents/anti-patterns.md. Checked: (1) apps/bot/src/domain/event.ts's isRequestUrgent -- mirrors isAutoPromotionHalted's exact shape/signature at a 48h threshold, evaluationTime is an explicit parameter, no internal clock read. (2) apps/bot/src/domain/notification.ts -- exactly two new NotificationKind literals (pending_request_urgent, registration_auto_declined), both distinct from every existing kind, no ledger schema touch (kind column is already text). (3) apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts -- confirmed rejectRequest's signature (organizerUserId: string, reason: string, at: Date) is completely untouched (git diff shows zero changes to that function); autoDeclineRequest is a genuinely NEW writer with its own signature/audit action (registration.auto_decline, actorUserId: null), reusing decideRejectionOutcome unchanged -- not a rejectRequest call with a null-organizer hack. getPrimaryOrganizerIdForChapter is deterministic (ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1), returns null on no-organizer, matching design §2.2/§7Q1. PendingRequestListItem.isUrgent is additive and computed via isRequestUrgent(row.startsAt, evaluationTime) fresh on every read in both listPendingRequestsForOrganizer and getPendingRequestForOrganizer -- never cached/stored, matching isAutoPromotionHalted's established pattern. (4) apps/bot/src/scheduler/autoDeclineJobs.ts and urgencyJobs.ts -- both new files are framework-free (no grammy import), no now()/current_timestamp in any predicate (evaluationTime threaded through explicitly, confirmed by grep). The job loop calls autoDeclineRequest(db, ...) once per candidate inside its own for-loop -- autoDeclineRequest opens its own db.transaction per call, so each candidate commits independently, NOT one giant batch transaction; when outcome.kind !== 'reject' the loop moves on with zero notification calls and zero ledger writes, confirming the state-guard (admission='requested' re-selection filter, Mechanism 2) is structurally independent of the notification_ledger unique-key guard (Mechanism 1) -- verified these are two separate mechanisms on two separate tables, neither implemented in terms of the other. selectRegistrationsForAutoDecline's registrationClosesAt-IS-NULL-OR-endsAt-fallback selection matches design §3.1/§3.2 exactly; the catch-up-window 'relevant close instant' is correctly computed per-row in JS (documented reason: no CASE-based column selection convention exists in this codebase). (5) apps/bot/src/handlers/organizerRequests.ts -- urgentMarker prefix applied to both the list row and the detail header, sourced from the catalog, no new command/callback added, matches design §2.4's 'no AC pins exact placement' allowance. (6) apps/bot/src/domain/registrationApproval.db.test.ts -- confirmed this is a genuine required update: listPendingRequestsForOrganizer/getPendingRequestForOrganizer both genuinely widened with the new evaluationTime parameter this run adds project-wide, and the two call sites in this REQ-035 test file needed the same update every other caller received (apps/bot/src/handlers/organizerRequests.ts's five call sites). No assertion content changed, no behavior under test changed -- purely a signature-widening follow-through, not scope creep and not an accidental behavior change to REQ-035's existing coverage. (7) i18n -- read the actual en.ts/ru.ts strings: urgentMarker '[Urgent] '/'[Срочно] ', urgentNotification and autoDecline.notification are plain, factual, sentence-case, no exclamation marks/emoji/slogans, and explicitly disclaim personal judgment ('Nobody reviewed and declined it -- the window simply closed before a decision was made' / Russian parallel). Confirmed both en.ts and ru.ts and types.ts carry matching keys (organizerRequests.urgentMarker/urgentNotification, top-level autoDecline.notification) -- no literal user-facing strings found via reading the two job files and the handler diff. BACKEND-DEV's handoff explicitly records this wording as provisional pending the product owner, satisfying AC8's process requirement. (8) Schema/migrations -- git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts is empty and no migration files appear in the changed-file list; confirmed zero schema changes as the design claims. (9) No new npm workspace, no build-output relocation -- Docker rebuild not required.
